'''Towers''' ---- '''Towers''' are, for the most part, the main way to counter [[enemies]]. They are essential to a player's loadout and gameplay. Each tower has its own set of abilities, purchase cost and upgrades associated to that particular tower. Most towers are offensive towers. However, some may provide support in its own way. Each have their own strategy associated to them and most towers can reach their full potential when combined with other towers or fighting against specific types of enemies. In [[PVP]] mode, golden perks and exclusive towers are unable to be equipped.
